package.name: waypoints
package.description:
Simple waypoint list server for the P3DX (Pioneer 3-DX) workspace: it keeps a list of 2-D waypoints and publishes it as a geometry_msgs/PoseArray.
THIS PACKAGE IS A RECONSTRUCTION, NOT THE ORIGINAL WORK. The original `waypoints` package was lost (the gitlink pointed at commit 115553cfa8c2ace122414ac5a9b235cd2e225693, which is not in any known remote). See README.md in this package for what is known, what is inferred and what is still missing.
package.author: Andre Neto
